host: user-authorized Windows workstation; owned disposable Win32 fixture only

task.initial_model_prompt: From the supplied screenshot of the owned fixture window, select one point inside the fixture client area, x=24..300 and y=24..150, to click before entering the harmless word office. Return only integer x and y.
task.direct_second_model_prompt: The screenshot is from the same owned fixture immediately after the click and text-entry action. Return {"save":true} only if the visible fixture text is exactly Agent Interface Win32 fixture: office. Otherwise return {"save":false}.

arms.direct: AppServer model selects a click point; standard public caller clicks and types office; after a fresh screenshot the model decides whether to save; standard caller saves.
arms.compiled: AppServer model selects the same click point; run_public_compiled uses local task predicates over public observations to perform click-and-type then save as two graph transitions, with no second AppServer turn.

measures: provider turn count and AppServer reported input/output/reasoning tokens
AppServer model latency and total observation-to-independent-oracle latency
standard public observation, dispatch, result and oracle call counts
exact task effect, action release, independent all-up state, fresh observation and cleanup
interpretation: Two counterbalanced pairs (n=2 per arm) are descriptive only. AppServer protocol usage is not independent upstream billing evidence; image-token accounting is unavailable. No causal or reliability claim is permitted.
